name: Banh dau xanh
summary: Bánh đậu xanh is a Hội An gift cake with a pork and mung-bean filling that is sweet, salty, and rich. The dried cake is crisp, and a meatless cake is also made.
origin: Hội An, and a childhood snack for people who live there.
taste: The pork filling is sweet, salty, and rich. The dried cake is crisp. Eat it with hot tea.
howToEat: Eat the dried cake with a cup of hot tea. Ask for the meatless cake if you do not eat pork.
seoTitle: Banh dau xanh — Hoi An mung-bean cake
seoDescription: Bánh đậu xanh Hội An has a pork and mung-bean filling that is sweet, salty, and rich, or a meatless cake. The dried cake is crisp, eaten with hot tea.
